subject: Visitor clearance & staging plan for Horizon Energy exec workshop
messages:
From: Ops Lead <ops_lead@horizon.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Cho <alan.cho@horizon.com>, Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@horizon.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Upcoming exec workshop - badges & staging logistics

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for coordinating the onsite workshop at our Denver site on May 18-19. A few quick asks from our facilities and security teams so we can process guest badges and arrange meeting room staging:

- A finalized visitor list (full name, company, DOB or passport # if required by our building) by EOD May 10.
- Confirmation of badging process for international attendees: will Redwood pre-register and bring printed badges, or do we need to run them through our kiosk?
- Any vendors/AV crews that need contractor badges and escort requirements.
- A simple site map for drop-off, staging area, and short-term storage for props/equipment.

Can you confirm who on your side will be the onsite liaison and whether you have a pre-filled visitor form we can use to speed approvals?

Appreciate it — Sandra (PA) is copied to coordinate arrival times.

Best,
Evan Parker
Operations Lead, Horizon Energy

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@horizon.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming exec workshop - badges & staging logistics

Hi Evan / Sandra,

Thanks — we'll take this off your plate. Quick answers and plan below, and I've attached the visitor registration template and a draft staging map for your review.

1) Visitor list: We'll collect full name, company, email, phone, and passport number where required. I'll share the compiled CSV by May 9 so you have a day for approvals.

2) Badging approach: Redwood will pre-register all attendees and produce lanyard badges on our end for Redwood staff and guests. For any non-Redwood vendor/AV crew, we'll request contractor badges from your kiosk and escort them per your policy. If facility requires passport numbers for international guests, please flag which badges need that — we'll include it in the CSV.

3) Onsite liaison: Grace O'Connor will be the primary onsite liaison (contact below). Rafael Mendes will handle AV vendor coordination and be onsite for setup.

4) Drop-off & staging: Attached is a staging map with recommended drop-off times and a gear holding area. We suggest a rolling delivery window the morning of May 18 to avoid lobby congestion.

5) Escort & access: We'll run a 10-minute pre-brief with your security lead on May 17 to confirm escort flow and badge scanners. Can your team make time for that?

Attachments: [Attachment: visitor-req-form.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: onsite-staging-map.png (image/png)], [Attachment: redwood-badging-sla.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Next steps: Grace will send the pre-registration CSV template and a short checklist by EOD tomorrow. Rafael will follow up with AV questions (power drops, mic types).

Thanks — excited to get this organized.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Thanks Marissa, Evan — I will own the onsite liaison tasks. A couple of operational notes from Redwood's side: 

- Pre-registration: I'll send the populated CSV (name, company, email, phone, passport if required) on May 9. Please confirm whether Horizon requires DOB or passport for US citizens as well — some buildings ask for DOB for background screening.
- International guests: For two attendees travelling from EU, we'll need passport numbers; let me know if Horizon requires notarized copies (uncommon).
- AV/vendor badges: Rafael, please confirm vendor list and expected arrival times by May 7 so Alan can pre-issue contractor badges.
- Escorting policy: We'll follow your standard escort cadence. For execs, we'll request an initial lobby escort to the staging room and then a single dedicated escort for the suite during the event.
- Emergency access: Can you provide the site emergency contact and on-call security phone? We'll add to our runtime contact card.

I'll attach a one-page cadence for morning deliveries and badge pickup to simplify the lobby handoff.

Grace O'Connor
Events & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
